caveat: When operated in FIPS mode and configured according to the Entropy Token Section of the Security Policy. There is no assurance of the minimum strength of generated keys
level_exceptions: Cryptographic Module Ports and Interfaces: Level 3
description: The FortiOS is a firmware based operating system that runs exclusively on Fortinet's FortiGate/FortiWiFi product family. The FortiOS provides integrated firewall, VPN, antivirus, antispam, intrusion prevention, content filtering and traffic shaping and HA capabilities.
tested_configurations: FortiGate-300D with the Fortinet entropy token (part number FTR-ENT-1)
allowed_algorithms: Diffie-Hellman (CVL Certs. #1272 and #1287, key agreement; key establishment methodology provides between 112 and 201 bits of encryption strength); EC Diffie-Hellman (CVL Certs. #1272 and #1287, key agreement; key establishment methodology provides between 128 and 256 bits of encryption strength); RSA (CVL Certs. #1272 and #1287, key wrapping; key establishment methodology provides 112 or 128 bits of encryption strength)
